desc: Build trie with per-node depth and prefix count; store each word's path node IDs for O(1) on-path lookup.
Precompute cnt_ge[L] = number of nodes at depth L with original count >= k.
For each word, binary search max L satisfying: (L<=len and on-path count>=k+1) OR (L<=len and cnt_ge[L]-(on-path count>=k)>=1) OR (L>len and cnt_ge[L]>=1); output 0 fallback.
Verify on Example 1 ([3,4,4,3,4]) and Example 2 ([0,0,0]); SAMPLE TESTS verdict: PASS.
Confirm monotonicity of validity in L (parent count >= child count) justifying binary search.
Handle k=1 (reduces to max remaining word length), duplicates, word-is-prefix-of-another, and n-1<k edge case (returns all zeros).
